1.explanation: 1. TableBatchActions (in TableBatchActions.js) is the React component that renders the selected-items summary and the action buttons. It currently only shows the totalSelected count and Cancel button, so it must be extended to render a new “Select all” link/button in its markup. 2. translateWithId (in the same file) provides the i18n for the summary message; it needs a new key (e.g. 'carbon.table.batch.selectAll') and logic to format the “Select all” label. 3. TableBatchActions.propTypes must be updated to accept new props (onSelectAll callback, optional selectAllLabel or a flag to show the link). 4. getBatchActionProps (in DataTable.tsx) is the method that gathers and passes props into TableBatchActions; it must be enhanced to supply the DataTable’s internal selectAll action and the overall row count (for the total across pages) so that when the new link is clicked, it can invoke selectAll across all data rather than just the current page.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots show the DataTable’s batch action bar opened after selecting rows. In the first image, the bar reads “50 items selected” only, while the design requires an extra “Select all (1228)” link next to that summary. In the second (Gmail) example, after selecting all items on the current page, a “Select all 24,521 conversations in Primary” link appears next to the “All 50 conversations on this page are selected” text. The request is to add the same “Select all (totalRows)” control into our TableBatchActions component beside the `totalSelected` count.

2.explanation: The TableBatchActions component is responsible for rendering the batch action bar, including the summary of totalSelected and the Cancel button. To add a “Select all” button next to the summary, this component must be extended (in its render method) to accept new props (e.g. onSelectAll, shouldShowSelectAll, totalItemCount) and render an additional Button alongside the Text span. Likewise, DataTable’s getBatchActionProps method must be updated to pass through these new props (the handler to select all items across pages and the overall item count) into TableBatchActions. These are the two core pieces of logic that need to be modified to fulfill the feature request.
2.bug_scenario: In a paginated DataTable with batch actions enabled, users can currently select only the rows on the current page, and the TableBatchActions component shows a summary like “50 items selected” along with a Cancel button. The design calls for an optional “Select all” control immediately adjacent to the summary text (e.g. “Select all (1 228)”) so that users can extend their selection to all rows across all pages. The example screenshots show a blue batch bar with “50 items selected | Select all (1228)” and, in Gmail, “Select all 24 521 conversations in Primary.”
